text.font-family: PingFang SC, Hiragino Sans GB, Microsoft YaHei, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 图 6 活动图 —— 出牌循环与结算

text.font-family: PingFang SC, Hiragino Sans GB, Microsoft YaHei, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 一局中最主要的循环：出牌 → 跟牌判定 → 本墩结果，直到手牌打完进入结算（来源：RoomActor.stepPlay / onHumanTimeout）

text.font-family: PingFang SC, Hiragino Sans GB, Microsoft YaHei, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: [PLAYING] 轮到某家出牌

text.font-family: PingFang SC, Hiragino Sans GB, Microsoft YaHei, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 轮到真人且连接在线？

text.font-family: PingFang SC, Hiragino Sans GB, Microsoft YaHei, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 玩家点选牌（复合身份 code#occurrence）→ 点「出牌」

text.font-family: PingFang SC, Hiragino Sans GB, Microsoft YaHei, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 跟牌合法？

text.font-family: PingFang SC, Hiragino Sans GB, Microsoft YaHei, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: FollowValidator

text.font-family: PingFang SC, Hiragino Sans GB, Microsoft YaHei, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 出牌成功：写命令日志 → 广播 event + 各家私有快照

text.font-family: PingFang SC, Hiragino Sans GB, Microsoft YaHei, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 手牌已全部打完？

text.font-family: PingFang SC, Hiragino Sans GB, Microsoft YaHei, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: [SETTLING] 算分（抠底 ×2）/ 血数 / 升级

text.font-family: PingFang SC, Hiragino Sans GB, Microsoft YaHei, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 级数已到 10（出锅）？

text.font-family: PingFang SC, Hiragino Sans GB, Microsoft YaHei, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 否

text.font-family: PingFang SC, Hiragino Sans GB, Microsoft YaHei, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Bot 出牌 / 超时托管代打（默认 32s）

text.font-family: PingFang SC, Hiragino Sans GB, Microsoft YaHei, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: ↩ 回到「轮到某家出牌」，牌局继续推进

text.font-family: PingFang SC, Hiragino Sans GB, Microsoft YaHei, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 否

text.font-family: PingFang SC, Hiragino Sans GB, Microsoft YaHei, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 拒绝出牌 + 返回可读原因

text.font-family: PingFang SC, Hiragino Sans GB, Microsoft YaHei, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 如「有首家花色必须跟出」；牌局状态不变，可重出

text.font-family: PingFang SC, Hiragino Sans GB, Microsoft YaHei, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 否

text.font-family: PingFang SC, Hiragino Sans GB, Microsoft YaHei, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 未打完 → 进入下一墩

text.font-family: PingFang SC, Hiragino Sans GB, Microsoft YaHei, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: ↩ 回到「轮到某家出牌」

text.font-family: PingFang SC, Hiragino Sans GB, Microsoft YaHei, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 否

text.font-family: PingFang SC, Hiragino Sans GB, Microsoft YaHei, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 未出锅 → 开新局（带进贡关系）

text.font-family: PingFang SC, Hiragino Sans GB, Microsoft YaHei, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: ↩ 回到图 5 的「发牌」步骤

text.font-family: PingFang SC, Hiragino Sans GB, Microsoft YaHei, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 回边：一局最多约 40 墩，每墩重复该循环
